title: Custom clients
intro.1: Build your own interface on the same API and viewer my web client uses, and turn off, per session, what your people should not do.
features-per-session.title: Features per session
features-per-session.1: Name the ones to turn off when you start a session; the rest stay on. The admin enforces them for every viewer, whatever the client sends, and lists them with the session.
features-per-session.5: Features apply to every viewer of the session, and are fixed for the life of the session.
host-your-client.title: Host your client
host-your-client.1: Build your interface as static files and point ADMIN_STATIC at them, in place of my web client.
host-your-client.2: The admin’s filesystem is read-only, so mount the files into it, read-only too, from an override file; they must be readable by its user, uid 10004. Then run bash install.sh again: it reads the override file.
host-your-client.3: It is then served from the admin’s own origin: the same login, cookie and CSRF token, and no new way in.
host-your-client.4: Scripts load from files on that origin (script-src 'self'): no inline scripts.
host-your-client.5: Browsers may keep the files under hashed/ for a year, so put there only files whose names change with their contents; every other file is checked again on each load. A .br or .gz copy beside a file goes to browsers that accept it.
host-your-client.6: The viewer SDK is at /sdk/viewer.js (an ES module), with its types at /sdk/viewer.d.ts, whatever ADMIN_STATIC holds.
the-viewer.title: The viewer
the-viewer.1: mountViewer(element, options) draws the session’s screen into the element and sends the person’s input. Everything around it, the bars, menus and prompts, is yours.
the-viewer.8: The rest of the API, sessions, control and downloads, is on the HTTP API page.
feature.keyboard-pointer: Pointer, wheel and keys from the person holding control.
feature.clipboard: Text the page copies, to the holder, and text the holder pastes.
feature.uploads: Files the holder drops on the page or gives its file chooser. Off, the chooser is answered with nothing.
feature.downloads: Files the page downloads, to the holder. Off, each one is cancelled.
feature.sound: The page’s sound, live and in recordings.
feature.recording: Recordings by the holder. A recording is a download, so it needs downloads too.
option.url-session: The session’s viewer WebSocket and its id.
option.features: The session’s features, as the API lists them. What is off is never sent or offered.
option.onlease: Who holds control: you, another viewer or the agent. Call setControl when it is you.
option.oncopied: Text the page copied, already on the clipboard or waiting for writeCopied() on a click.
option.onfilerequest: The page opened its file chooser: call choose() from a click, or cancel().
option.onuploads-ontransfer: Files on their way to the page, and each batch’s progress.
option.ondownloads: Files the page downloaded; each arrives through the browser’s own download.
option.onrecording: Where a recording is: started, ended or failed.
option.onsound-onstats-onerror: Whether sound plays, live statistics, and errors (fatal ones closed the stream).
method.setcontrol-on: Sends input while you hold control (off: you only watch).
method.writecopied-setautocopy-on: Copies the offered text, or copies everything automatically.
method.startrecording-layout-wire-defaul: A recording on the server, with Capture for camera and microphone.
method.close: Ends the stream and removes the screen.
